coordinateSystem: Unmodified DAMIT co-rotating Cartesian frame; positive Z is the north pole; positive X defines the meridian; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: DAMIT model 1814, version 2017-06-19: ecliptic J2000 lambda 103 deg, beta 11 deg, period 9.404937 h; equatorial J2000 conversion uses obliquity 23.439291111 deg. The original model page and DAMIT frame documentation are pinned. The display does not claim the source epoch phase.
